sense: the chief city of a country

terms.comment: The head of a country or a people, usually with a genitive: Thebes was the head of all Greece (Nep. Epam. 10, Lewis & Short).

terms.grammar: noun phrase: urbs with the adjective prīnceps
evidence: M-O s.v. capital, capital city, seat of government

terms.gloss: a mother city; the chief city of a province
terms.comment: Greek μητρόπολις: a city that founded colonies, and in late Latin the chief city of a province (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: abī, nūntiā … Rōmānīs, caelestēs ita velle ut mea Rōma caput orbis terrārum sit
phrases.english: go and tell the Romans that it is the will of heaven that my Rome be the capital of the world
